title: Pre-Analysis — Load-Sharing Carriage Standard Ahead of the Sealed Bearing Cartridge Proposal
abstract: Work order asking whether the load-sharing carriage standard should be maintained, revised or allowed to be superseded, raised after line-check wear reports and closed by delegating the decision to the door design authority.

sections.objective: Answer the question the operator order put to the programme: whether the load-sharing hook and roller carriage should be revised in place, held as it is, or allowed to be superseded by the sealed bearing cartridge proposal now in pre-analysis. The work order had to assemble the wear evidence held against the carriage, identify every document that would move with the standard, and state what a supersession would cost in manual and repair content before any position was taken.
sections.findings_summary: The evidence points one way and the decision does not belong here. The sealed cartridge candidate reuses the carriage rail part and its guide bush while replacing everything that runs on them, so it is a genuine supersession rather than a parallel option, and the two share the door zones outright. The wear survey bulletin has been recording carriage running surface condition against a baseline that the cartridge geometry makes meaningless, which is why the line-check reports read worse than the fleet actually is. The web fretting repair sits on the same hook seat and would need re-substantiation either way. The travel check task ties all three together and is the single piece of content that has to change first.
sections.next_steps: Hand the standard-versus-supersession decision to the door design authority with the wear evidence attached; this work order takes no position and is closed on that basis. Ask the survey bulletin owner to state the baseline the running surface limits are measured against before the next revision. Flag the travel check task as the first item to change under whichever outcome, and keep the fretting repair re-substantiation on the design authority's list rather than opening it here.

tasks.title: Assemble the wear evidence held against the carriage
Establish whether the cartridge proposal is a true supersession
List the content that moves with the standard
Check the door warning wiring for any dependency on carriage geometry

expected_findings.rationale: The candidate keeps the carriage rail and its guide bush and replaces everything that runs on them with a sealed cartridge. That is a supersession of this standard, not an alternative to it, and it makes any in-place revision of the carriage a dead investment.
expected_findings.resolution: Refer the decision to the door design authority with the supersession position stated.

evidence.similarity_note: Both the entity link on the carriage rail and the similarity search on running surface wear return it at the top.

expected_findings.rationale: The survey records running surface condition against a carriage baseline. A cartridge aircraft has no such surface, so the survey effectivity ends the day the candidate is embodied and the fleet wear trend becomes uninterpretable across the break.
expected_findings.resolution: Ask the bulletin owner to state the baseline explicitly and to close the effectivity at the supersession point.

expected_findings.rationale: The travel check and running surface examination is the entry point for every latching finding on the line. Whichever way the decision goes, this task changes first, and today it has no way to say which standard it is examining.
expected_findings.resolution: Flag as the first manual change under either outcome.

expected_findings.rationale: The hook seat fretting repair was substantiated against the carriage contact pattern. A cartridge changes that pattern, so the repair needs re-substantiation before a repaired web can carry the new standard.
expected_findings.resolution: Leave with the design authority as part of the supersession case.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares both door zones and the ATA 52-70 warning context and is returned by every latching search. The proximity target and its harness are unchanged by any of the three carriage options, and the sheet carries no carriage identifier.

type_data.conclusion: No position taken here. The supersession case is established and the standard-versus-revision decision is handed to the door design authority with the evidence attached.
